notes.title: Summer 2019
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We'd like to thank you all for your ongoing support and patience for Eitr! It's been a long road but we're finally starting to see the end of the tunnel. 

Eitr is currently being scheduled for a Summer 2019 release.

In the coming months, we will have more information and media to share as we close in on release and rekindle the 'hype train'.

Again, thank you all for your continued support!

Derity.

notes.title: VaatiVidya Eitr Demo Preview

For those of you that missed it, check out this video of VaatiVidya playing the PSX Eitr Demo!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a-YatMGBqq0

I would also like to take this moment to thank all of you for your on-going feedback and support, suggestions, criticism and general comments all are helping us to make Eitr the game we want it to be!

Regards,
- David (Derity) Wright
